create_stand_task: create a humanoid CMU stand task environment with a 20 second time limit
create_run_task: create a humanoid CMU run task environment targeting a speed of 10 m/s
get_physics_head_height: get the head height of the humanoid CMU from the physics simulation
get_physics_extremities: get end effector positions in the egocentric frame from the physics simulation
get_humanoid_observation: get an egocentric observation dict with joint angles, extremities, and velocity
